decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-4d26c029a26e], is a one-line release note: "Added Support for multiple addresses in IstioEndpoint model". It names an internal data model but no user-facing subject such as a CRD field, flag, annotation or API, so the subject cannot be typed. It also states no condition that would expose an environment and no effect on operators who do nothing, so applicability and consequence cannot be determined. A more detailed source is needed, such as the linked PR/issue 47273 or the related dual-stack or multi-address documentation, to say what changed for users, if anything.
